themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and take actions within research workflows.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad spectrum of AI tools designed to assist or automate various aspects of research, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that assist software developers in writing, debugging, and reviewing code.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the use of AI-generated personas or simulated users for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Highlights how AI is used to analyze customer data, feedback, and behavior to derive actionable insights.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers AI applications that directly aid in the design process, from generating mockups to informing design decisions.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Discusses the application of AI to automate various stages of testing, including functional, performance, and security testing.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, such as research papers, articles, or meeting transcripts, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Examines the use of AI in the recruitment process, from sourcing candidates to analyzing job market trends.

themes.name: AI ethics in research
themes.description: Addresses the ethical considerations and challenges arising from the use of AI in research and user studies.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
